title: Implement blocked GF(p) echelon / RREF (026fc832 Phase 6)
description:
Phase 6 implementation task under epic `026fc832`. Implements the blocked echelon/RREF per design `24a93e4e`, building on the panelized PLE implementation.

Parent epic: `026fc832`. Predecessors: `24a93e4e` (design), panelized PLE implementation (sibling).

## Amendment (2026-05-27, user-approved, session 11)

R0 evidence (`dev/bench_results/2026-05-26-869ce43b-blocked-echelon.md`) closed 14 of 18 A8 echelon cells PASS (rows 18-22, 26-32, 72-73). The remaining 4 cells are routed per user-approved decision (session 11 AskUserQuestion: "Investigate GF(251)/n=64 borderline first; amend the rest"):

- **Rows 24, 25** (GF(251)/n=256 uniform + deficient @ 3.62× / 5.19×): `[aspirational]` inheriting the `6823c8a0` GF(251)/n=256 PLE-side gap. The blocked-echelon Stage-3a GEMM has no path to close these cells until the underlying panelized PLE hits 1.5× at GF(251)/n=256 (currently 2.35×/2.38× per `6823c8a0` R1 evidence). Closure requires the blocked Schur-update kernel or float-cascade PLE work tracked under 6823c8a0's existing [aspirational] amendment.
- **Row 23** (GF(251)/n=64/deficient @ 1.60×): deferred to follow-up task `d36cc414` (GF(251)/n=64 borderline investigation).
- **Row 33** (GF(2^31-1)/n=1024/deficient @ 2.37×): deferred to follow-up task `6a7d4c8e` (M31 echelon: wire `m31_batch_dot_fn` into `gemm_axpy_into_view`).

## Background

Closes A8 rows 18-29, 30-33, 72-73 (echelon cells over GF(7/251/65521/2^31-1) and GF(31)).

## Success Criteria (current — amended 2026-05-27)

- [hard] Production code implementing the blocked echelon per the approved design.
- [hard] Bit-exact correctness vs the existing `FieldMatrix::rref` on a proptest sweep across GF(7), GF(31), GF(127), GF(241), GF(251), GF(65521), Mersenne31 at boundary lengths plus rank-deficient cases.
- [hard] 5-trial CCX1-pinned benchmarks at n in {64, 256, 1024} per prime per regime (uniform + deficient where the predecessor scorecard measured both).
- [hard] [AMENDED 2026-05-27 — see Amendment block above] Every A8 echelon cell (rows 18-33, 72-73) either PASSes (ratio ≤ 1.5× vs fflas) OR carries an explicit user-approved [aspirational] amendment OR is closed by a named follow-up task. Rows 24, 25 are [aspirational] at 3.62× / 5.19× inheriting 6823c8a0's GF(251)/n=256 PLE-side gap. Row 23 is deferred to `d36cc414`. Row 33 is deferred to `6a7d4c8e`.
- [hard] No regression on currently-PASSing cells (delta ≤ 5%).
- [hard] No `unsafe` outside kernel crates.
- [hard] Reuses panelized PLE + `fp_small_try_gemm_classical` per the design.

## Original Success Criteria (pre-amendment, preserved for audit)

- [hard] Every A8 echelon cell (rows 18-33, 72-73) either PASSes or carries [aspirational] amendment.

## Out of scope

- Sibling impls (PLE, invert, solve).
- GF(251)/n=256 echelon cells (amended `[aspirational]` 2026-05-27 — closure deferred indefinitely unless a successor epic prioritises blocked Schur-update or float-cascade PLE).
- GF(251)/n=64/deficient echelon (deferred to `d36cc414`).
- GF(2^31-1)/n=1024/deficient echelon (deferred to `6a7d4c8e`).
